fact: The Malawi Electoral Commission's Chief Elections Officer said in a 5 June 2025 response that Sections 20 and 21 of the 2023 Elections Act limit voter-roll inspection to verification of entries at registration centres and regional offices.
source_slug: 2025-06-08 MEC Rejects Observer Coalition's Electronic Voter Register Access Request

fact: The Principal Secretary says the law makes the Malawi Electoral Commission recognise the national ID as the single source of truth for voter registration, after Parliament made it the only proof of identity.
